name: Datadog
one_liner: Observability platform with a broad HTTP REST API (v1/v2) per Datadog site.
auth_notes: Classic: DD-API-KEY (write/submit) plus DD-APPLICATION-KEY (reads). OAuth2 clients exist for third-party apps (granular scopes; confidential clients). Newer PAT/SAT tokens per first pass (not re-verified). Multiple regional sites (us1, us3, us5, eu, ap1, ap2, uk1, gov) require per-customer base URL.
access_notes: Credentials are created in the customer's Datadog org; a free trial exists but pricing is paid per product. No self-serve free tier shown on fetched pages. Rate limits raised via support.
sandbox_or_test_env: Free Datadog trial account (duration not verified on fetched pages)

api_surface.webhooks: outbound webhooks integration (Datadog calls your URL from monitor alerts)

buildability.rationale: Well-documented REST API and keys, but needs a Datadog org (trial or paid), per-site base URLs, two-key auth, and endpoint-specific rate limits; many features are product-plan dependent.

disputes.why: Pricing page is paid-only credits/products; free trial exists but no free tier. Not directly verified whether API works on trial.
Classic API+app key auth is simple and documented; the real gate is needing a paying/trial Datadog org.
Official rate limit page documents 429 and X-RateLimit headers.
Webhooks integration page: monitor alerts POST to a configured URL.

auth.quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header DD-API-KEY. For some endpoints, you also need an Application key
Datadog uses the OAuth 2.0 (OAuth2) Authorization Framework to allow users to securely authorize third-party applications’ access

access.quote: Use these resources to test out and learn about the unified Datadog platform.

sandbox.quote: Learn without cost on real cloud compute capacity and a Datadog trial account.

api_surface.quote: The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.

mcp.quote: It provides remote access to most Datadog products (APM, logs, metrics, monitors, dashboards, security signals, and more).

buildability.quote: Requests that read data require full access and also require an application key.

identity.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
